_doc: Pre-registered time-gated reads, executed by owed-read-runner.py (hourly, signal-1, 27 * * * *). OPS-OWED-READ-RUNNER-W1.
A wave declares a read with ONE row here plus ONE reviewed script ops/monitoring/owed-read-<slug>.py installed beside the runner; no new cron line, inventory row for the runner, or alert id.

Row keys (strict; _-prefixed keys are comments): id [a-z0-9-] = marker filename and OWED_READ_FAIL page-on-change key; wave; not_before / expires_at (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ); script; timeout_s (1..1800); anchors (handed to the script on stdin; the script refuses anchors that differ from its own pre-registration); criteria (one line, shown on the page).

Verdicts: PASS / FAIL are terminal (marker in /var/lib/algovault-monitoring/owed-reads, written only after the canary_result_log 'owed_read' record landed); INDETERMINATE retries every tick until expires_at, then ONE expired INDETERMINATE record. Only FAIL pages (OWED_READ_FAIL, once per read id).

Rollback: delete the row (its marker stays as evidence; a FAIL key leaves the page set and the alert clears). This file reaches the host by declaration-sync.sh, which refuses a >50% size shrink - a deletion it refuses is installed with ops/scripts/install-monitoring-artifact.sh instead.

reads.criteria: Did CH1's HL candle-request fix catch up its 8-coin cohort? L1: 0 post-deploy cohort HL API 500 / Blocking HL lines; L2: no coin retried-and-unfilled with 0 fills; L3: cohort workable_reachable <= 26. One read-only snapshot; lens parity + plan guard, else INDETERMINATE.
reads._expires_at_rule: R2 install time + 72 h, rounded up to the hour (OPS-OWED-READ-RUNNER-W1 §Rulings); the original 2026-10-21T06:00:00Z lapsed while the R0 rulings waited; the first committed value 2026-10-25T11:00:00Z assumed a 2026-10-22T10:xx install, and the second (2026-10-27T09:00:00Z) a 2026-10-24T08:xx one; the install ran in the 2026-10-24T11:xx hour.

reads.criteria: PASS = no (route, client /24) pair with >= 3 gzip/deflate-labelled requests answered 2xx on >= 2 distinct UTC days in api-encoded-requests.log since install, the chain covering back to the install's control line and the running Caddy config still logging there; FAIL = those pairs, with UA families (R-FLIP stays off); else INDETERMINATE.
reads._expires_at_rule: not_before = install_at (2026-10-24T16:47:05Z, the Caddy reload) + 14 d, rounded up to the hour; expires_at = not_before + 72 h.

reads.criteria: Did CH1 end the BingX closed-market freeze? A: no R0.2 cohort row (162 ids) still in reach with outcome_filled_at NULL; B: no BINGX|NC* coin_silent page on 2 UTC dates in [deploy+72 h, deploy+6 d]; C: no BingX 109429/418/429 ban row since deploy. One read-only snapshot; anchor parity, coverage and instrument guards, else INDETERMINATE.
reads._expires_at_rule: not_before = deploy_at (2026-10-29T16:52:32Z, CH1's app container start) + 6 d, rounded up to the hour; expires_at = not_before + 72 h.
